headline.en: Your agent's proxy metric is climbing. Is the real outcome?
headline.zh: Agent 的代理指标一路上涨，真实结果呢？

sub.en: ProxyDrift time-aligns your agent's decision stream with the late-arriving ground-truth outcome stream, and flags the window where the two diverge — correlational heuristic, code-stamped, never a causal verdict.
sub.zh: ProxyDrift 把 Agent 决策流与延迟到达的真实结果流做时间对齐 join，在背离窗口立刻亮旗——相关性启发式由代码强制盖章，绝不冒充因果结论。

body.en: The agent acts on day t; the real outcome only lands at t + lag_days. ProxyDrift bucket-joins the two streams on calendar days, shifts the outcome by your lag, and never interpolates — missing outcome days surface as coverage gaps, not fabricated data.
body.zh: Agent 在第 t 天做决策，真实结果要 t + lag_days 才到达。ProxyDrift 按日桶 join 两条流、按你的 lag 后移结果流，绝不插值——缺观测的决策日如实列为覆盖缺口，不造数据。

body.en: A window flags only when the proxy trend climbs above +θ (σ/day, full-series normalized), the lag-aligned outcome sinks below −θ, and their correlation drops under −0.3. Adjacent windows merge; suspect actions rank by proxy mass; every flag carries the verdict label "correlational heuristic — not a causal verdict".
body.zh: 一个窗口亮旗，当且仅当：代理趋势爬过 +θ（σ/天、全序列归一）、lag 对齐后的结果沉到 −θ 以下、两者相关系数跌破 −0.3。相邻窗口自动合并；嫌疑动作按代理体量排序；每面旗都由代码盖章「correlational heuristic — not a causal verdict」。

title.zh: 国产模型审计叙事（可选）

body.en: Set ZHIPU_API_KEY or DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and ProxyDrift asks GLM-4 / deepseek-flash to narrate the flagged window into an audit paragraph embedded in report.html. No key? It skips gracefully. The verdict label is stamped by code — the LLM never overrides it.
body.zh: 配置 ZHIPU_API_KEY 或 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，ProxyDrift 会请 GLM-4 / deepseek-flash 为亮旗窗口写一段审计叙事，嵌入 report.html。没有 key 就优雅跳过。判定标签由代码盖章——LLM 永远无权改写。

note.en: Deterministic synthetic creator-growth replay, seed 20260914 — the same run `proxydrift demo` produces on your machine.
note.zh: 确定性合成回放（seed 20260914）——与你本机 `proxydrift demo` 的输出逐字一致。

steps.body: 两条 CSV 进，一面旗（或没有旗）出——退出码 0/1/2 可直接接 CI

body.en: One command to see the mechanism; your own two CSVs to use it for real.
body.zh: 一条命令看懂机制；换上你自己的两条 CSV 就是真用。

limitations.zh: 判定永远是相关性启发式，不是因果结论——这是代码强制盖章的红线，不是免责套话。
limitations.en: Verdicts are correlational heuristics, never causal conclusions — code-stamped, not disclaimer boilerplate.

limitations.zh: v0.1 只做离线批处理 CSV/JSONL；没有实时流接入、没有 Web 面板（报告是自包含 HTML）。
limitations.en: v0.1 is offline batch CSV/JSONL only — no streaming ingestion, no web dashboard (the report is self-contained HTML).

limitations.zh: 硬性前提：你需要同时拥有代理决策流与可按日期 join 的延迟真实结果流；没有结果流就没有 oracle。
limitations.en: Hard precondition: you need both a proxy decision stream and a joinable delayed ground-truth stream; no outcome stream, no oracle.

title.zh: 仪表盘一片绿，转化在悄悄掉
title.en: The dashboard goes green while conversion sinks

body.zh: 你把业务指标交给 Agent 优化，真实结果要 7 天、30 天后才从 CRM 里浮现，于是你交给它一条可即时测量的代理指标。Agent 精确地优化你交给它的东西——互动量确实在涨。问题出现在别处、也更晚：涨上来的互动是标题党和 emoji 蹭来的，真正该涨的关注转化在掉。OpenAI 在《我们如何监控内部 Coding Agents 的失配》里确认：代理改善而结果变差的 reward hacking 是生产级 Agent 真实存在的失效类别。他们的方案不出大门；ProxyDrift 回答的是你机器上的版本——指标和结果背离了吗？
body.en: You hand the agent a measurable proxy because the real outcome lands 7–30 days later. The agent optimizes exactly what it was handed — interactions climb, the dashboard goes green. The problem shows up elsewhere and later: the clicks came from shock titles, and the conversion that pays the bills is sinking. OpenAI's internal monitoring write-up confirms reward hacking — proxy improving while the outcome degrades — as a real production-agent failure class. Their answer never leaves the building; ProxyDrift is the version for your own data: did the metric and the outcome diverge?

body.zh: eval 与可观测性面板打分的就是交给 Agent 的那条指标——回路里没有任何环节在比对代理位移和下游结果位移。等结果明显不对时，漂移往往已经复利了几周。ProxyDrift 把两条流按日桶 lag 对齐 join，缺口如实呈现，绝不插值。
body.en: Eval and observability dashboards score the same metric the agent was given — nothing in the loop compares proxy movement against downstream outcome movement. By the time the numbers look wrong, the drift has compounded for weeks. ProxyDrift lag-joins the two streams on daily buckets, surfaces gaps, never interpolates.

alt.zh: 双流 lag 对齐 join

body.zh: 亮旗窗口内，每个 action_id 按贡献的代理体量排序——title_shock、topic_pileup、emoji_bait 直接点名。自包含 HTML 报告画出双趋势线、给亮旗窗口涂上阴影带、附上嫌疑动作表；判定标签由代码盖章，LLM 叙事只能加注、不能翻案。
body.en: Inside a flagged window, every action_id ranks by the proxy mass it contributed — title_shock, topic_pileup, emoji_bait, named outright. The self-contained HTML report draws the dual trend lines, shades the flagged windows, and tabulates the suspects; the verdict label is code-stamped and the LLM narrative can annotate but never override it.

body.zh: lag、窗口宽度、θ 阈值、相关阈值、嫌疑上限全部可以从命令行覆盖；默认 lag=7 天、window=14 天、θ=0.05、corr<−0.3。
body.en: lag, window width, θ threshold, correlation threshold, and suspect cap are all CLI-overridable; defaults are lag=7d, window=14d, θ=0.05, corr<−0.3.
